title: Acrisius
summary: Raleigh names Acrisius in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Acrisius, King of the Argiues, father of Danae, slaine vnwillingly by Perseus; eldest sonne of Abas after Lynceus. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book II, Part I, Chapter XIII, §. II, sig. 264b–265a
